title: A time with no date concatenated to text reads 1:05:00 PM

source.quote: CONCATENATE converts numbers, dates, and Boolean values to text with the default format
source.supports: a date joined to text takes the default format; the page says & gives the same result as CONCATENATE

source.quote: FORMAT accepts a set of predefined format strings for Date/Time
source.supports: the example shows General Date of 2021-01-02 15:30 as 1/2/2021 3:30:00 PM and Long Time as 3:30:00 PM

derivation: TIME ( 13, 5, 0 ) is a datetime with a zero day part (1899-12-30). General Date shows 'a date and/or time': with no date part only the time is shown, in the en-US long time form 1:05:00 PM.
alternative: No source shows the implicit conversion of a time-only value. If the date part were printed the result would be 12/30/1899 1:05:00 PM.
